queries.query: LLM failures when generating network configurations; examples of hallucination, syntactic vs semantic errors, unsafe changes, case studies
queries.rationale: Characterize the phenomenon: what kinds of incorrect or unsafe outputs do LLMs produce in NetOps contexts and documented examples/case studies.

queries.query: Calibration, uncertainty estimation, and overconfidence in large language models; methods to quantify/output uncertainty (confidence scores, calibration curves, selective prediction)
queries.rationale: Mechanisms that explain why LLMs output confidently even when wrong and methods to measure or calibrate that behavior for operational safety.

queries.query: Prompt sensitivity and compositional failure modes for LLMs in structured-output tasks (instruction brittleness, few-shot/chain-of-thought fragility)
queries.rationale: Mechanistic causes of variability/errors arising from prompting choices and chain-of-thought or multi-step generation in configuration tasks.
source_preferences: engineering blog posts only when pointing to primary references

queries.query: Generate–validate–repair architectures: LLM + external verifier/tool loop for producing corrected network configs (tool-assisted self-correction, tool calls, verifiers-as-oracles)
queries.rationale: Mitigation architectures that combine generation with deterministic validators or repair modules to reduce unsafe outputs.
source_preferences: GitHub repos and tool docs (Batfish, Veriflow examples)

queries.query: Network verification and policy-analysis tools: Batfish, Veriflow, NetPlumber, NICE, HSA, NetKAT — capabilities, APIs, and use for automated validation
queries.rationale: Concrete verifiers that can evaluate semantic correctness of generated configurations (reachability, ACL violations, loops).

queries.query: Intent-based networking and configuration synthesis literature (translating high-level intent to device configs; semantic models and constraint solving)
queries.rationale: Neighbouring domain describing operational workflows and synthesis problems analogous to LLM-driven NetOps tasks.

queries.query: Benchmarks and evaluation suites for LLMs in networking and AIOps (6G-Bench, TSNBench, OpsEval, NetBench, public AIOps benchmark collections): scope and limitations
queries.rationale: Assess benchmark validity and gaps for operational NetOps tasks; identify what existing suites measure and what they miss.

queries.query: Evaluation metrics for operational correctness and safety in NetOps: reachability, isolation, policy compliance, ACL semantics, loop detection, change-rollback safety, MTTR implications
queries.rationale: Define measurable, operationally meaningful metrics to evaluate LLM outputs beyond surface-level correctness.

queries.query: Simulation and emulation environments for NetOps experiments (Mininet, ns-3, GNS3, containerized routers, virtual labs): fidelity, scalability, instrumentation for automated testing
queries.rationale: Methods to execute, test, and validate generated configs in controlled environments that approximate production behavior.
source_preferences: network systems conference papers using these environments

queries.query: Public datasets of network configurations and topologies (CAIDA, RIPE, public BGP dumps, GitHub config corpora); curated corpora for training/evaluation
queries.rationale: Data sources for building evaluation tasks, training prompts, or realistic scenario banks for NetOps experiments.

queries.query: Adversarial testing and robustness for LLM-driven NetOps: prompt adversarial examples, maliciously crafted inputs, and robustness evaluation protocols
queries.rationale: Understand worst-case failure modes and how adversarial inputs or edge-case scenarios can break generation+validation pipelines.
source_preferences: security and ML robustness literature (USENIX Security, CCS, NeurIPS)

queries.query: Human-in-the-loop oversight, approval workflows, and operator interface designs for LLM-assisted NetOps (guardrails, explainability, audit trails)
queries.rationale: Operational mitigations that rely on human oversight; design patterns to integrate LLM outputs into safe operational processes.

queries.query: Program synthesis, code-generation verification, and symbolic/SMT techniques applicable to verifying generated configuration fragments
queries.rationale: Mechanisms and tools from PL/formal methods to check or symbolically reason about generated configs and scripts.
source_preferences: SMT/tool docs (Z3, Isabelle) and applied examples

queries.query: Operational safety, auditability, and accountability for autonomous NetOps: legal/regulatory/organizational constraints and incident-response frameworks
queries.rationale: Contextualize risk mitigation needs beyond technical fixes; requirements for logging, provenance, and post-incident analysis.

queries.query: Prior work applying LLMs specifically to network configuration generation, repair, or NetOps automation (papers, demos, tool integrations)
queries.rationale: Identify nearest prior art that directly overlaps with the fixed topic family to position novelty and avoid duplication.

queries.query: Experimental design and statistical methods for evaluating LLMs in NetOps tasks: paired designs, randomization, sample size estimation, metrics aggregation, significance testing
queries.rationale: Methodological backbone for rigorous experiments and preregistration: how to structure tests and analyze results appropriately.

queries.query: Reproducibility, provenance, and tooling for ML-driven experiments: dataset versioning, prompt logging, hashes, experiment manifests, CI for scientific runs
queries.rationale: Operational requirements from the programme for traceability and verification of autonomous runs and for producing reproducible artifacts.
source_preferences: platform docs (DVC, MLFlow, GitHub Actions) and best-practice guides

inclusion_criteria: Primary sources (peer-reviewed papers, arXiv preprints with verifiable metadata, tool papers, official benchmark/project pages)
Works that include concrete methods, APIs, code, datasets, or experiments amenable to reproduction
Recent material (prefer 2019–2026) for LLM-related topics; include older seminal works for network verification and formal methods
Publicly accessible artifacts (papers, repos, datasets) or stable identifiers (DOI, arXiv ID, citation metadata)
Sources that directly inform phenomenon, mechanism, mitigation, benchmark validity, methods, or neighbouring domains
exclusion_criteria: Unverifiable citations or secondary summaries without primary-source links
Pure marketing/marketing blog posts that lack technical detail or reproducible artifacts (unless they point to primary sources)
Social-media snippets, forum posts, or unverifiable hearsay
Papers lacking sufficient metadata (no authors, no venue/identifier) or known to be retracted
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2019–2026 for LLM-specific methods and empirical studies while including older seminal works (network verification, formal methods, intent-based networking) as necessary to explain foundational mechanisms and tools. This balances recency in fast-moving LLM work with established networking/formal-methods foundations.
